title: Canonical derived cup product of condensed internal invariants
statement: Use the internal action categories, normalized derived invariants $F_{R,J}$, exact trivial inflation $L_{R,J}$, group restriction and the canonical derived adjunction of [def-sfb-condensed-derived-invariants]. Use the ordinary diagonal action tensor and trivial-inflation tensor comparison of [def-sfb-condensed-action-tensor]: the strong forgetful tensor comparison has underlying relative internal-module tensor, and on every profinite test object the action sends $x\otimes y$ to $jx\otimes jy$. Its regular tensor unit has trivial action, and its symmetry, associators and unitors are the ordinary ones under the forgetful comparison. Use the ordinary K-flat derived tensor on base and action module categories. Trivial inflation is strong monoidal with the identity underlying ordinary tensor comparison; its derived tensorator is fixed by the generic flat-term K-flat representative normalization of [lem-derived-right-exact-tensor-comparison], and its unit by localization of the ordinary regular-unit comparison. Its right adjoint $F_{R,J}$ has the lax monoidal structure obtained by taking the tensor-of-counits mate. Put $C_R(J)=F_{R,J}(R[0])$ with the actual trivial regular module in degree zero. Identify this coefficient object with the derived action tensor unit using the localized regular-unit comparison. Define its multiplication by transporting the unit multiplication, and define the cup multiplication and cup unit by applying $F_{R,J}$ and its lax structure. Define the restriction arrow on $C_R$ by $b_u$ followed by the localized trivial-coefficient identification. For an object $X$ define right-associated tensor powers by $X^{\otimes0}=R[0]$, $X^{\otimes(n+1)}=X\otimes^{\mathbf L}X^{\otimes n}$; for a unit $e$ and product $m$, define ordered products by $m_0=e$ and $m_{n+1}=(1\otimes m_n);m$. No factor is permuted.
